verdict.rationale: Insomnia's docs describe role-based access control (RBAC) for fine-grained control over who can access which Insomnia resources. RBAC is also listed as a feature on the pricing page, and organizations let users share collections and environments securely with colleagues. missing for 10: documentation of specific roles and view-vs-edit permission levels for APIs/collections, details on how permissions are assigned per project or collection, independent or hands-on corroboration.
